name: range-calendar
title: Range calendar
description: A month grid for picking a start and an end date.
a11y: role="grid" with column headers; one day is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Enter or Space on a day sets the start, then the end; Escape while picking clears the start.
Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the start and end of the week, PageUp/PageDown by month; arrows are mirrored in right-to-left.
The days between start and focus are previewed while picking, by hover and by keyboard.
Each day button has a full date name; start and end have aria-pressed; a status region announces the chosen range.
Disabled days (min, max, isDateDisabled) are real disabled buttons.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previousMonth?: string | undefined; nextMonth?: string | undefined; }
props.description: Texts for the month arrows, for other languages. Defaults are English.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected range when controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially selected range when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called after every pick. The first pick gives `{start, end: null}`; the second completes the range.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday. Default 0.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date; earlier days are disabled.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date; later days are disabled.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Return true for a day that cannot be picked, such as a holiday.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for month and day names.
